summary: StudentDetail manages the storage, retrieval, update and deletion of student response details to headings/questions, with support for sorting, numbering, formatting, caching, and conditional release of contact information. StudentDetail objects are tied to a student and heading, and store response text, numbering metadata, and display flags. Business logic enforces data validation, formatting, and handles workflow steps for CRUD operations.
purpose: To represent, manage, and maintain detailed responses and metadata for students, typically in support of placement or assessment workflows. This includes providing CRUD operations, display formatting, numbering/indentation logic, and conditional data release.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: ID of the student this detail belongs to

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of the detail or heading

fields.name: WebPage
fields.description: Flag if entry is a web page

fields.name: HeaderChanged
fields.description: Flag if heading changed since last entry

workflows.name: StudentDetail CRUD
steps: Add: Validate response; Use StudentDetailsAdd stored procedure; Add parameters (SessionID, StudentID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder, NumberingCodeID); Execute query.
Update: Validate response; Use StudentDetailsUpdate stored procedure; Add parameters (SessionID, StudentDetailID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder, NumberingCodeID); Execute query.
Delete: If ID != 0; Use StudentDetailsDelete stored procedure; Add parameters (SessionID, StudentDetailID); Execute query.
GetByStudentID: Use StudentDetailsSearch stored procedure; Add parameters (StudentID, SessionID); Retrieve list.
GetByID: Use StudentDetailsSearchID stored procedure; Add parameter (ID); Retrieve list.
FillList: For each record, set fields; handle header changes; calculate numbering/indent; format sort order; set WebPage flag; handle translation if alt language used; Add to list.

workflows.name: Conditional Contact Release
steps: Check PlacementRequest status; If student is in group or individual assigned list; If StudentEmailReleased and request is CONF and endDate+5 >= today, release email; If StudentPhoneReleased and request is CONF and endDate+15 >= today, release phone.

business_rules: SortOrder of -1 is displayed as blank.
Response must not be blank; else error message.
Numbering character and indentation calculated per entry using NumberingCodes logic.
WebPage flag set if Description matches Resources.WEB_PAGE.
HeaderChanged marks when HeadingID differs from last entry.
If UseAltLanguageFields is enabled, Description is sourced from DescriptionAlt.
validations: ID must be non-zero for Update/Delete operations.
calculations: Numbering character and indent level per entry by SetNumberingCharacter.
Sort order formatted as empty if -1; else as integer.
conditions: If entry.Description == Resources.WEB_PAGE, set WebPage true.
If UseAltLanguageFields enabled, Description is replaced.
Contact Release only if PlacementRequest is CONF and student is assigned.
system_behavior: Caches StudentDetail lists for short periods to optimize repeat calls; caching removed if it causes stale refresh.
Uses stored procedures for database operations.
Handles multiple DB calls gracefully via caching logic.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for DB access and messaging.
Resources for description and error messages.
Students, PlacementRequestDestinations for contact release rules.
exceptions: If response is blank, Add/Update fails with error.
ID must be non-zero or operation aborted for Update/Delete.
content_gaps: No UI layer or permission/authorization details present.
No explicit error handling for DB failures.
No elaboration of NumberingCodes internal logic.
